title: Annu Projects IPO Details
intro:
Annu Projects IPO is a book build issue of ₹175.06 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.77 crore shares of ₹175.06 crore.

Annu Projects IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 25, 2026 and will close on Aug 28, 2026. The allotment for the Annu Projects IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 31, 2026. Annu Projects IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 2, 2026.

Annu Projects IPO is set issue price band at ₹94 to ₹99 per share. The lot size for an application is 151 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,949 (151 shares) (based on upper price).

Mefcom Capital Markets Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Annu Projects IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Updated on Aug 25, 2026 Annu Projects Limited is an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company. It is engaged in the design, development, implementation, operations and maintenance of essential overhead and underground utilities infrastructure across telecom infrastructure, sewerage infrastructure vertical and gas pipeline vertical. Key Verticals: Telecom Infrastructure: Surveying, designing, and installing cabling and tower infrastructures for communication, automation, and electronic security system. Its customers include Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited, A2Z Infra Engineering Limited, Bharat Broadband Network Limited, G R Infraprojects Limited. Sewerage Infrastrucutre: Pipe laying, construction of manholes, construction of sewerage treatment plants, construction of pumping stations, and construction of structural facilities, etc. Gas Pipeline: Laying MDPE ranging from 20 mm to 125 mm in diameter, along with 38,300 GI house connections for domestic and commercial gas supply. Served customers, including Indraprastha Gas Limited, Gujarat Gas Limited and GAIL India Limited. As on June 30, 2026, it has 23 ongoing projects worth Rs 19,593.48 million, including 4 telecom infra projects, 14 sewerage, 4 gas pipeline projects and 1 (one) comprised of railway signalling vertical. faqs.question: How to apply in Annu Projects IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Annu Projects IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Annu Projects IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Annu Projects IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Annu Projects IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Annu Projects IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Annu Projects IPO opens on Tue, Aug 25, 2026 and closes on Fri, Aug 28, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Annu Projects IPO?
faqs.answer: Annu Projects IPO lot size is 151 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,949 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Annu Projects IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Annu Projects IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Annu Projects IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Annu Projects IPO will be done on Monday, August 31, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 1, 2026 . Check the Annu Projects IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Annu Projects IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Annu Projects IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 2, 2026 .
